title: Blind fixed-domain dynamic prescribed-head representation transfer
scientific_question: Does the lower-zone-focused LARE representation frontier remain sufficient when the lower boundary changes from a fixed zero-head water-table condition to an independently forced time-varying prescribed-head condition?

workload.top_boundary: gravity-consistent qeq only for every history; no top perturbation
workload.lower_boundary: fixed-domain mode-5 prescribed pressure head during RISE/FALL symbols; mode-2 equilibrium hold otherwise

blind_histories.design_rule: Half-offset state and boundary perturbations inside the already qualified BC1 range, frozen without inspecting any C4Y Reference response.

R2.role: 2 x 80 cm current-canonical Richards comparator on exact C4Y histories

FMC_SMVE.reason: Frozen FMC_GW200 authority is specific to the zero-head fixed-water-table formulation. C4Y does not silently invent a dynamic prescribed-head FMC boundary equation.

DYNAMIC_GW_VECTOR: absolute pooled mean signed bottom-flux error
maximum absolute final cumulative-bottom-exchange error across histories
maximum reversal penalty in steps; a reversal-count mismatch is assigned the full 1024-step horizon
metrics.PROFILE_VECTOR: DYNAMIC_GW_VECTOR plus mapped 10-cm R16-cell theta RMSE
metrics.crossing: componentwise no worse than R2 within 1e-12 numerical equality tolerance

hypotheses.H_DYNAMIC_HEAD_MIN_NOT_BELOW_R4: The minimum lower-zone ladder dimension crossing R2 on the dynamic GW vector is not below R4.
hypotheses.H_LOWER_ZONE_PLACEMENT_R4: At dimension 4, lower-zone R4 is componentwise no worse than uniform U4 on DYNAMIC_GW_VECTOR.
hypotheses.H_LOWER_ZONE_PLACEMENT_R8: At dimension 8, lower-zone R8 is componentwise no worse than uniform U8 on DYNAMIC_GW_VECTOR.
hypotheses.H_PROFILE_REQUIRES_MORE_STATE: The minimum R2-relative PROFILE dimension is greater than the minimum R2-relative GW dimension.

decision_logic.C4Y_DYNAMIC_HEAD_GW_PROFILE_FRONTIERS_PR: All hard gates pass and at least one reduced lower-zone LARE member crosses R2 on both DYNAMIC_GW_VECTOR and PROFILE_VECTOR.
decision_logic.C4Y_DYNAMIC_HEAD_GW_FRONTIER_ONLY: All hard gates pass and at least one reduced lower-zone LARE member crosses R2 on DYNAMIC_GW_VECTOR but none crosses PROFILE_VECTOR.
decision_logic.C4Y_DYNAMIC_HEAD_REDUCED_FRONTIER_NOT_PR: All hard gates pass but no reduced lower-zone LARE member crosses R2 on DYNAMIC_GW_VECTOR.
decision_logic.C4Y_REFERENCE_OR_EXECUTION_BLOCKED: Any Reference, integrity, provenance or fail-closed gate fails.

interpretation_boundaries: C4Y is a fixed-domain prescribed-head laboratory, not moving-water-table geometry.
C4Y is not a SWAP-MODFLOW coupling experiment and changes no production groundwater-coupling semantics.
R2-relative crossing is comparator-relative representation evidence, not application acceptance.
No FMC result is inferred outside the frozen zero-head FMC authority.
No layer boundary, closure, history, metric or threshold may be retuned after C4Y response exposure.
No performance or speedup claim is made.

pre_execution_implementation_binding.allowed_new_code: history materialization, R2/R16 current-canonical execution plumbing, frozen-vector aggregation only
